point_b: A deployed LifeRE surface operates through the canonical LifeOS/Universal Overlay shell and a real authenticated browser-extension session proves observe-select-act-verify-receipt-runtime-truth on at least one bounded reversible LifeRE action without ordinary founder clicks; SENTRY Layer B returns PASS from live evidence.
continuation_invariant: Point B false plus exhausted authored slices is BLUEPRINT_EXHAUSTED_RETURN_TO_ARCHITECTURE, never idle-success.

history.archive_policy: Prior/superseded material is provenance only, never executable authority.

steps.title: Re-measure deployed LifeRE and Overlay reality
steps.task: Run/read the canonical LifeRE acceptance, real-app E2E, Universal Overlay A-to-Z acceptance, production health, and Layer-B receipt paths. Produce a single current-state receipt separating PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, fixture-only, and live-proven evidence. Do not repair in this slice.

steps.title: Converge real Body execution path
steps.task: Close the product-home convergence finding by making the general BodyAdapter real-action path delegate to the already-existing overlay-action-router / extension-drive-bridge path where appropriate. Do not create a third control pipeline. Preserve fail-closed behavior when no authenticated browser session exists.

steps.title: Remove founder-presence dependency from Layer B technical proof
steps.task: Provide a governed browser/extension test harness or equivalent machine-controlled real browser path that can establish the live session needed by SENTRY Layer B without requiring ordinary founder clicking. If browser-extension installation/authentication is a true capability boundary that cannot be automated in the deployed environment, emit HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER with the exact one-time human bootstrap required; do not pretend it is solved.

steps.title: Prove LifeRE action through Universal Overlay
steps.task: Using a real authenticated session, open the canonical LifeRE surface and perform one bounded reversible action through Universal Overlay. Capture observation evidence, selected target and rationale, action receipt, post-action independent verification, and runtime truth. Fixture-only evidence cannot pass.

steps.title: Run SENTRY Layer B and deployment closure
steps.task: Run the real SENTRY Layer B proof and LifeRE acceptance against deployed reality. PASS only if both are live-proven and production health is not degraded by the change. Emit READY_TO_DEPLOY, DEPLOYED_AND_PROVEN, or a typed blocker; never infer readiness from queue completion.

steps.title: Learning-loop hardening
steps.task: For every failed or corrected decision in LREUO-001..005, preserve the responsible model/provider/attempt evidence when available and record: decision made, evidence available, evidence missed, assumption made, why existing governance/gates did not catch it earlier, and the smallest reusable verifier/gate/role/blueprint change that prevents recurrence. Never invent hidden chain-of-thought; ask for or use explicit rationale/receipts/logs only.

model_failure_policy.rationale_capture: Capture explicit model output, stated assumptions, tool evidence and receipts. Never request or claim access to private chain-of-thought.

completion_rule: Not complete until live SENTRY Layer B and the bounded LifeRE-through-Overlay action both PASS in deployed reality.
